title: A few words that reach the heart
odia:
କିଛି କହେ ନାହିଁ ସରମରେ
ପଦିଏ ପଦିଏ କହି ଦେଉଥାଏ
ବାଜି ଯାଉଥାଏ ମରମରେ।
literal_meaning: Says nothing out of shyness; yet says a little phrase at a time, and it strikes deep in the heart.
meaning_odia: ଲାଜରେ କିଛି କହେ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି କୁହାଯାଉଛି, ଅଥଚ ପଦିଏ ପଦିଏ କଥା କହିଦିଏ ଯାହା ହୃଦୟକୁ ଛୁଇଁଯାଏ। ଅଳ୍ପ କଥା ମଧ୍ୟ ମନରେ ଗଭୀର ପ୍ରଭାବ ପକାଇପାରେ।
explanation: The opening presents someone as too shy to speak, then immediately describes the few words they do say. Those short phrases reach deep into the listener’s feelings. This editorial reading preserves the contrast between apparent reticence and the force of a little speech.
usage_example: A quiet friend says only a few words about a shared memory, but they stay with the listener long afterwards. The saying could describe that moment. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ସରମରେ and ମରମରେ link shyness with the inner heart through rhyme. The repetition ପଦିଏ ପଦିଏ slows the speech into small phrases, making their deep effect stand out.

witnesses.locator: Page11, three lines beginning କିଛି କହେ ନାହିଁ ସରମରେ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026. Upload prints the anomalous ଯାଉଥଶଏ. Display conjecturally emends this to ଯାଉଥାଏ on grammatical grounds and its parallel with preceding ଦେଉଥାଏ. No independent whole-saying witness confirms the repair.

graphic.caption: An imagined quiet conversation shows how a few words can hold another person's attention.

english_summary: A seemingly reticent person’s few words can reach deep into the heart.
